findings.explanation: The universal, exceptionless causal guarantee in the chapter exceeds the plan’s mechanistic ceiling and the source mechanism’s limited statement of behavioral reasons; the packet also expressly forbids guaranteed outcomes.

assessments.rationale: CH-U001-001 contains a supported description of the Facebook Like button corresponding to SRC-U001-CLAIM-001, so the named specificity is allowed. PLAN-U001 requires no special framing. However, the chapter adds an absolute causal guarantee unsupported by SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001 and prohibited by SRC-U001-ATOMIC-016, making support partial and claim strength unfit.
